title: haven: directory URLs hard-wired to https://{provider_domain}
description: mimi-hubd 2c14e62 directory() builds endpoint URLs as https://{provider_domain}{path}, coupling endpoint location to the user-URI authority. protocol-06 §5.1 L1015-1018: the directory conveys the URLs 'as opposed to hard coding the endpoints'; its example uses mimi.example.com. Not a MUST violation; a design defect that prevents reverse proxy / non-443 / separate API host deployments. Harness workaround: user+net namespace with socat on haven.localhost:443 (mimid-1wgh.46.1.5). Issue text drafted at /tmp/claude-1000/-home-mark-PROJECT-mimid/68c47ff1-5bf1-4cc7-8578-600b5b59e0f3/scratchpad/haven-issue-baseurl.md; posting needs Mark's OK.
close_reason: Reported upstream with Mark's OK: https://github.com/havenmessenger/interop/issues/3. Follow via watch bead mimid-1wgh.37.91.10.
